heic.title: How to turn HEIC photos into JPEG
heic.intro: HEIC conversion is turned off on this service while HEVC licensing is reviewed. You can convert the photos to JPEG on your own device and then turn them into a PDF.
heic.iphone1: For new photos: Settings › Camera › Formats › “Most Compatible”. The camera will save photos as JPEG.
heic.iphone2: To copy them to a computer: Settings › Photos › “Transfer to Mac or PC” › “Automatic”. Photos copied by cable are converted to JPEG.
heic.mac1: In Preview: File › Export… and choose the JPEG format.
heic.mac2: In the Finder (macOS 12 or later): select the photos, Control-click › Quick Actions › Convert Image › JPEG.
heic.next: Then convert the JPEG files to PDF:
